The thesis

History is more than a price chart.

Since 2009, Bitcoin has developed a history of technical milestones, market cycles, debates and cultural moments. Bitcoin Archives explores whether there is meaningful community interest in documenting and preserving that history for future generations.

“Which moments in Bitcoin’s history should never be forgotten?”
Our current objective

Measure genuine interest before going further.

The scope is deliberately narrow. The immediate task is to listen, learn and understand whether the idea resonates—without presenting an unbuilt product as if it already exists.

01 / LISTEN

Invite discussion

Ask which Bitcoin milestones, ideas and cultural moments deserve to be remembered.

02 / OBSERVE

Authentic engagement

Assess real participation and discussion, not manufactured hype or artificial trading volume.

03 / BE TRANSPARENT

No premature promises

No assumptions about future products, development, timelines or outcomes. Interest remains to be assessed.
